answer: Start from capability token minted only after identity proof. Every identity must clear it before its first answer counts. Cloning 629 keys multiplies the price 629-fold: 57868 POA locked, or 9435 minutes burned, against a single honest agent's one-time cost. The timber sits in the mechanism itself, the reef sits in the price of faking it, and the plume sits in the record no template can forge. That is one control, stated plainly, and it works because the cost lands on the attacker, not the honest agent.
